scripts._comment_typecheck_tests: tests/ are outside tsconfig.json's include (that project emits dist/ and must not ship the suites), so they are checked by their own config — see tsconfig.test.json. Blocking in CI (#1001).
scripts._comment_catalog: Regenerates shared/src/generated/mcpToolCatalog.json from the built registry (#1210). Run after adding or renaming a tool; toolCatalogFreshness.test.ts fails until you do.
scripts._comment_deploy: Remote MCP on Cloudflare Workers. Build first — wrangler.jsonc's main is dist/worker.js, not src/. wrangler is NOT a dependency (same call as deploy-web.yml: npx, major pinned), so nothing here is installed for a package that only deploys. Secrets: npx wrangler@4 secret put <NAME>. Plan: .claude/docs/vision/plans/2026-09-09-remote-mcp-mobile.md
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy
